note: The RPC request supplies an attribute array count for C_CreateObject; the PoC sets n_attrs to 1.
The outer CKA_WRAP_TEMPLATE attribute carries an encoded length of 24 bytes, equal to one CK_ATTRIBUTE structure.
Because the outer attribute type is CKA_WRAP_TEMPLATE, its value is decoded as an attribute array and the nested count is read from the input.
The sizing pass reports only the nested attribute structure size, not the serialized nested attribute data that will be copied during the second pass.
The server allocates only temp.ulValueLen bytes for the outer template value; with one nested attribute this is 24 bytes.
During the second decode pass, the nested CKA_LABEL byte array copies the PoC-controlled 64-byte value through a pointer inside the undersized 24-byte outer allocation.
